brief: LUPA · Compare two versions of a page with genuine captures, sliding A/B, overlay, history and viewport reproducibility.

intent.experience: Let a human see exactly which pixels changed without confusing visual comparison with screenshot origin proof.
intent.distinctAbility: Make local screenshot pairs, exact diffs, SHA integrity, offline capture manifests and IndexedDB history work in one editorial interface.

references.observation: Official BackstopJS README describes reference/test separation, image diff, visual scrubber, reports and CI; reproduced ideas at behavior level only.
Auditor W002 found LUPA 10 captured fixtures but browser UI/IndexedDB E2E not observed; candidate gate for this run.

components.role: Authorized Chromium capture and locally reproducible viewport evidence
components.strategy: Python Playwright page.screenshot with explicit dimensions, no fabricated screenshots
components.constraints: URL hosts allowlisted by explicit arg; offline self-contained HTML mode; failure must be raised

components.role: Four-mode A/B visual comparator and pixel metrics within real raster dimensions
components.strategy: Native Canvas ImageData RGB comparison and CSS image clipping; every image comes from chosen file
components.constraints: No resizing dimension mismatches, no remote URL loading, large image limits and keyboard controls

components.role: Local comparison history and SHA provenance labels tied to originals
components.strategy: IndexedDB Blob entries, SHA-256 WebCrypto, optional runner manifest verification
components.constraints: Never imply unverified uploads are authenticated screenshots or that local storage persists across devices

questions.question: How can this runner obtain authentic screenshots if Chromium denies URL navigation in the execution environment?
alternatives: HTTP(S) navigation with explicit host authorization
Chromium page.set_content for local original self-contained HTML
questions.finding: Environment denied localhost URL as ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR; set_content produced genuine screenshots of authored fixtures.
questions.decisionImpact: Runner supports both authorized URLs and self-contained HTML with source hashes, never claims HTML mode verified a hosted URL.

questions.question: Which metric is actually observable without pretending perceptual or Lighthouse quality?
alternatives: Synthetic similarity percentage or performance estimate
questions.finding: Python Pillow measured 8,712 and 21,802 changed pixels at threshold 32 for fixture pair.
questions.decisionImpact: Displayed percentage is only changed pixels / total; no Lighthouse or subjective quality claim.

questions.question: How can users distinguish imported images from runner-sourced evidence?
alternatives: Treat all uploaded filenames as verified captures
Match SHA-256, dimensions and manifest pair; label others unverified
questions.finding: Unverified upload and manifest mismatch UI state observed in Chromium; secure WebCrypto manifest-match remains untested in this environment.
questions.decisionImpact: Use UNVERIFIED_UPLOAD by default; only label hash match when crypto.subtle can validate both files.

relations.invariant: Capture raster dimensions must exactly match between both sides before any image diff is shown.
relations.failure: Silently scaling screenshots produces false positive or hides actual layout regressions.
relations.test: Mismatched PNG upload disables diff and shows explicit dimensions.

relations.invariant: History stores the untouched source blobs and hashes, not a screenshot of the comparison UI.
relations.failure: Reopening saved history loses original evidence or mixes old diff with new images.
relations.test: Reload and restore same images in a secure-origin real browser, not run in current sandbox.

decisions.choice: Support genuine Chromium screenshots from local HTML when network route is blocked
decisions.rejected: Pretend that navigation to localhost succeeded
decisions.productionChange: Added --a-html/--b-html with SHA-256 of original HTML and explicit sourceType in manifest.
decisions.why: No screenshot provenance claim is valid without actual rendered PNG bytes and an unambiguous source type.

decisions.choice: Exact channel-threshold pixel count from decoded PNG
decisions.productionChange: Canvas in app and Pillow in runner implement RGB max-diff threshold 32 and numbers.
decisions.why: This calculation was actually exercised and can be reproduced under identical browser conditions.

decisions.choice: Local IndexedDB Blob records plus optional hash-verified runner metadata
decisions.rejected: Mark every upload as an authorized capture
decisions.productionChange: Explicit UNVERIFIED state and separate manifest matches; save/reload feature implemented but E2E not observed.
decisions.why: Provenance is a verified relation between bytes and a runner report, never just a file name.

risks.failure: Rendering produced fake raster or no real changed pixels on first fixture.
risks.prevention: Perform original fixture A/B Chromium first article before building full UI and inspect byte hashes.
risks.test: Observe screenshot file bytes and run Pillow diff with threshold 32 for 390 and 1440.

risks.failure: IndexedDB persistence fails in deployed secure browser context despite source implementation.
risks.prevention: Keep export independent of storage; document untested E2E.
risks.test: Save, reload, restore and compare hash in real served browser.

acceptance.criterion: CLI creates PNG and manifest for two original HTML fixtures and measures changed pixels.
acceptance.oracle: File bytes, SHA-256 and RGB differences from real Chromium run in local sandbox.

acceptance.criterion: Browser local UI accepts true PNG, rejects mismatched dimensions, switches modes and exports diff PNG.
acceptance.oracle: Playwright page.set_content at 390 and 1440, all modes and download events.

acceptance.criterion: First screen has distinctive visual protagonist without horizontal overflow at 390 and 1440.
acceptance.oracle: Inspect real Chromium screenshots for both viewports.

acceptance.criterion: Secure-origin history survives a full page reload and verified manifest changes label.
acceptance.oracle: Playwright navigation to served domain and IndexedDB readback, secure WebCrypto hashes.

acceptance.criterion: Public GitHub Pages serves identical bytes to candidate branch.
acceptance.oracle: External HTTP and real browser page load.

licensing: All fixtures and app authored for this task. Playwright Apache-2.0 and Pillow open source; no stock media, user data, or third-party protected screenshots included.
resources: Local /usr/bin/chromium, Python Playwright, Pillow, JS Canvas, IndexedDB, WebCrypto; no network navigation in sandbox.
environmentLimits: Chromium blocks direct localhost/file/data page.goto; screenshots created with Playwright set_content. No secure-origin history or SHA match E2E here; public Pages NOT_RUN, human approval false.

checks.oracle: Chromium screenshot inspected plus document.scrollWidth <= innerWidth

checks.oracle: Chromium screenshot plus DOM full-width inspection

firstArticle.rejectWhen: Images do not decode, raster dimensions mismatch silently, screenshots are placeholders, or changedPixel count is zero despite changed fixture
firstArticle.switchTo: DOM tree and computed-style semantic difference explorer
